Open the Bilibili dynamic composer with the text and photos, then review and post. Finish any existing draft first. If content is missing, use “Prepare text and photos.”
Couldn’t open Bilibili’s composer. Use “Prepare text and photos” to post manually.
Open WeChat Moments with the text and a single photo, then review and post. If content is missing, use “Prepare text and photos.”
WeChat’s composer entry accepts text alone or one photo. Multiple photos will be saved to an album and the text copied. Select the photos and paste the text in WeChat Moments before posting.
Couldn’t open WeChat Moments. Use “Prepare text and photos” to post manually.
Edit the photos in Douyin and tap “Next,” then review and post. If a share menu appears, choose “Go to post.” Douyin sets its own photo limit.

Douyin doesn’t bring in text with photos, so the text is copied before Douyin opens. Edit the photos and tap “Next.” Then paste the text into the description, review, and post. If a share menu appears, choose “Go to post.”
Douyin doesn’t accept text-only shares. Select at least one photo, or use “Prepare text and photos” to copy the text and compose the post yourself.
Couldn’t open Douyin’s share screen. Make sure Douyin is installed and up to date.

Open the Threads composer with the text, then review and post. If a share menu appears, choose “Post.” Finish any existing draft first. Edits here apply only to this share. Threads sets its own text limit.
Threads doesn’t bring in text with photos, so the text is copied before Threads opens. Paste it into the composer, then review and post. Threads sets its own photo and text limits.
Couldn’t open Threads. Make sure it’s installed.
Review the text and photos and add a title in Xiaohongshu before posting. Edits here apply only to this share. Xiaohongshu sets its own photo and text limits.

Xiaohongshu doesn’t bring in text with photos, so the text is copied before Xiaohongshu opens. Paste it into the body, add a title, then review and post. Xiaohongshu sets its own photo and text limits.
Couldn’t open Xiaohongshu. Make sure it’s installed.
Choose a destination in Telegram, review the text and photos, then send. Edits here apply only to this share.
Telegram doesn’t bring in text with more than one photo, so the text is copied before Telegram opens. Choose a destination and paste the text into the caption. Then review and send.
Couldn’t open Telegram. Make sure it’s installed.
%1$d photos selected, shared in their original order. Tap a photo to select it.
Review and post in X. Edits here apply only to this share. X sets its own text limit.
%1$d of %2$d photos selected, shared in their original order. Tap a photo to select it.

“Prepare text and photos” saves the selected photos to a separate album and copies the text. Then select, paste, and post in the other app yourself. It works for WeChat Moments, Bilibili, Feishu, and any other app; choose photos within that app’s limits.
%1$d photos selected, saved in their original order. Tap a photo to select it.

With a token, you can edit and delete the site’s Moments. Your edits and the Moments you write here stay on this phone until you review and publish them together. The token stays on this phone and isn’t backed up.
Saved changes stay on this phone until you publish them to the site

Publishing makes everything here public. New Moments and their photos and videos are uploaded, edited ones are updated, and deleted ones are taken off the site. If publishing stops partway, anything not sent stays here.

Only during an assisted share started in Here, reads the target app and runs its adapted steps. Stops before sending and does not store chat content. Currently supports Telegram and Threads photo shares, stopping after 40 seconds if unfinished.
No photos selected. This will use ordinary text sharing.
Enable the accessibility service first, or turn off the assistant to share manually.
Search for the username below, select it, check the recipient and photo count, and fill the caption. Stops before sending. Runs only when you open this share; turn it off to share manually.
Selecting the Telegram recipient and filling the caption…
Recipient and caption ready. Review in Telegram and send manually.
Assistant stopped. Check the recipient and caption manually in Telegram. It will not retry automatically.
Enter a public username, such as @username or https://t.me/username.
The assistant currently supports Telegram 13.1.0. Turn it off to share manually with another version.

Keeps the shared photos and fills the body, stopping before Post. Review text and photos manually. If share options appear, choose the composer manually. Stops on a different draft, an unknown page, or after 40 seconds. Turn it off to share manually.
Text filled. Review text and photos in Threads and post manually.
Assistant stopped. Check photos and text manually in Threads. Existing drafts are preserved and there is no automatic retry.
The assistant currently supports Threads 452.0.0.50.64. Turn it off to share manually with another version.
Tracks stay on this phone and are never published to the API. The basemap uses the network; recording works offline.
Record while moving and rest while still. Tracks may appear about a minute later; the beginning of movement may be missed.
Trips share samples with daily recording. Ending a trip leaves daily recording on.
Recorder is on, waiting for an accurate fix
Location is off. Recording resumes when it is enabled.
Allow precise location in app settings, then resume recording.
Operation failed. Check permissions and available storage, then retry.

Background recording uses a persistent notification. Allow location all the time to resume after a reboot. If your phone restricts background activity, allow it in battery settings. Reopen the app after force stopping it.
No track for this period yet. Enable recording; accurate fixes collected as you move will appear here.
Export current raw samples as GPX
Only reliable, continuous fixes are connected. Poor signal or missing samples leave gaps; the endpoint waits for confirmation.
Includes unused fixes and accuracy for reanalysis. Samples discarded by older versions cannot be recovered.
Turn off daily recording and end the active trip before deleting. Export a backup first; uninstalling the app removes local tracks.
This cannot be undone. Days and trips share samples; deleting also removes those samples from the other views.
The recorder could not start. Open footprints to check permissions and resume recording.
Automatically controlling recording on selected connection changes
Connection automation is unavailable. Turn it off and on to retry.
Automation paused. Check notification, background location and Bluetooth permissions.
Wi-Fi name unavailable. Check location permissions and the system location switch.
Choose Wi-Fi networks or Bluetooth devices below first

Wi-Fi: automatically pause on joining a selected network and start on leaving all selected networks.
Bluetooth: automatically start when any selected device connects and pause when all disconnect.
Bluetooth takes priority: a selected Bluetooth connection prevents Wi-Fi from pausing recording; simultaneous disconnections follow the Bluetooth pause rule.
Starting resumes a paused trip or daily recorder, or enables daily recording if neither is on.

Changes apply automatically after settling for 5 seconds. Initial snapshots do not change recording. Manual changes cancel pending actions until the next connection change.\nAn ongoing notification keeps the watcher running without requesting location fixes or scanning devices. Settings and execution logs stay on this phone.

Automatic recording needs precise location, Allow all the time, system location enabled, and notifications. Bluetooth rules also need Nearby devices access. After granting access, turn connection automation on again.
Current, system-cached and saved networks are shown. If a network is missing, connect to it in system settings and reopen this list. Networks with the same name count as one Wi-Fi network.
Pair devices in system settings first, then reopen this list. Recording pauses automatically only after all selected devices disconnect.
Daily recording is resting. GPS is off until movement or the next check.

Allow Live Updates to show the current state in the status bar:
Track: receiving valid locations.
GPS…: waiting for a valid location.
GPS off: system location unavailable.
Rest hides the live activity; its status remains in the notification drawer and footprint panel. The live activity returns when location resumes. Pausing or stopping removes the live status. On ColorOS, enable live activities in Fluid Cloud. Other systems may use different names and displays.

Footprints: receiving valid locations.
Crosshair: waiting for a valid location.
Warning triangle: system location unavailable.
Rest hides the status bar icon; its status remains in the notification drawer and footprint panel. Pausing or stopping removes the recording notification. The chain icon only indicates connection automation.
Visibility follows system notification settings. Some systems replace ordinary notification icons with the app icon.

Investigates missing tracks and battery use without coordinates. Live logs stay on this device, up to about 2 MB. Exports add track decisions, break reasons and totals for the latest recorded day, so the file may be larger.
Android blocked the background start. Open footprints to resume recording.
Off. The phone’s motion sensor remains in use.
Google Play services unavailable. Standard motion detection remains active.
Allow physical activity access or turn this enhancement off.
Helping detect walking, cycling and travel in a vehicle.
Activity recognition unavailable. Standard motion detection continues.
Optional. Requires Google Play services and physical activity access to help daily recording resume sooner. Stillness is advisory and does not pause a trip. Tracks stay on this device.
Once the system confirms the link, a chosen Bluetooth device connecting or disconnecting can wake the monitor; coming near does not. Without a link the rules work as before.
System association was not completed. Standard monitoring remains available.
This Android version uses standard notification icons.
App notifications are disabled; status cannot appear in the status bar.
Live Updates are not allowed. Enable them in system settings.
No recording notification is currently posted.
Waiting to save power; Live Updates are intentionally hidden.
The system has promoted the recording notification to a Live Update.
Live Updates are allowed, but this notification is not promoted. Check its channel or manufacturer settings.
Unable to read system notification state.
